description.expected: LakeHouse Studio public template for AEC open-source tools — Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, BIM, and design automation starters with OpenSSF-aligned CI (tier: public).

docsSite.justification: Ship a per-repo Starlight scaffold as the flagship seed for one org docs hub on the custom domain (when Sen sets REPLACE_WITH_CUSTOM_DOMAIN). Matches the monorepo Astro choice; avoids *.github.io as the public hostname by using the org.json domain for canonical/OG URLs once set. Other repos can deep-link into the hub later.

analytics.justification: GoatCounter is free for non-commercial/open-source, privacy-friendly (no cookie banner required in typical setups), zero-cost to self-host or use the free hosted tier, and does not require a business Cloudflare plan. Wire the script only after Sen creates a site — never enable tracking until verification is ready.
